rules: Select only candidates matching the declared target, outcome group, estimand, and allowed data family.
Treat each source-defined population stratum and non-overlapping calendar period as a separate evidence context; within one context, select no more than one competing estimate.

Age strata may both contribute only when their source-defined populations do not overlap. Separately reported calendar periods may both contribute only when the source does not identify overlapping participants.
Exclude a candidate from joint quantitative synthesis when its source metadata explicitly identifies an overlapping cohort with another eligible source record.
Use the source-reported effect representation and do not relabel an odds ratio as a risk or rate ratio, or vice versa.
Apply the extraction protocol's timepoint and effect-selection rules before synthesis.
Exclude source-only and quantitatively incomplete candidates from quantitative synthesis.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
